headline: Kai, the week bends toward Wednesday: a Fed set to hike into $100 oil, a 10-year at 4.96 percent, and bitcoin turned back at $80,000.
subline: A near-forecast CPI steadied stocks into the decision, the Houthis took Mayun island at the Red Sea's mouth, and Sweden votes today with the far right within reach of government.
asof: Sunday · markets closed · stocks, yields, gold and oil are Friday's close · bitcoin early Sunday via CoinDesk · every figure links to its source below

items.title: The Fed decides Wednesday; a hike is the base case
items.sentence: Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole message — summer's better inflation prints didn't prove the trend — moved Wednesday's hike odds from a long shot to roughly even or better across CME, Kalshi and Polymarket, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Stocks enter the week off a 0.9 percent rebound
items.sentence: Friday's rise to 7,656.98 on the S&P clawed back much of the week's losses once oil eased and August CPI landed close to forecasts, per the AP's wrap — the last full session before the decision.

items.title: Yields: tens 4.96, twos 4.63, mortgages steady
items.sentence: Advisor Perspectives' weekly snapshot has the 10-year finishing at 4.96 percent and the 2-year at 4.63, while Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage held at 6.76 percent for a second week.

items.title: Friday under the hood: VIX sinks to 15.84
items.sentence: StockMarketWatch's Friday digest shows the fear gauge down 11 percent to 15.84, gold easing 0.4 percent to $4,389.70 by its count, and WTI settling at $100.13, off 2.3 percent on the day.

items.title: Bitcoin's run at $80,000 fails into Fed week
items.sentence: Bitcoin touched $79,890 Saturday before fading back toward $77,000, a stall UseTheBitcoin ties to Fed-hike odds near 87 percent, Tuesday's CLARITY Act vote, and a fourth straight day of ETF outflows through Friday.

items.title: Spot check: $77,266, flat over 24 hours
items.sentence: CoinDesk lists bitcoin at $77,266 early Sunday, off 0.02 percent over 24 hours, which for bitcoin counts as parked.

items.title: Houthis seize Mayun island at the Red Sea's gate
items.sentence: The Iran-backed group seized Mayun island in the Bab el-Mandeb strait — the passage carrying about 12 percent of world trade — and says shipping is safe for everyone but Saudi vessels, per NPR.

items.title: BRICS declaration urges 'maximum restraint' in the Mideast
items.sentence: Leaders meeting in India, Putin and Xi among them, adopted a joint declaration pressing for 'maximum restraint' in the Mideast, per U.S. News.

items.title: Sweden votes with the far right near power
items.sentence: Polls opened Sunday in a general election that could put the far right in government for the first time, per The Times of Israel's live coverage.

items.title: Aoun visits Lebanon's south, vows Israeli withdrawal
items.sentence: President Joseph Aoun paid a rare visit to the southern city of Nabatiyeh as fears of new Israeli attacks grow, per the Washington Times.

items.title: The oil story behind Fed week: tit-for-tat strikes
items.sentence: U.S.–Iran exchanges and attacks around Hormuz stoked the supply worries that pushed Brent past $100 last week, per CNBC — the shock sitting under Wednesday's decision.

items.title: OpenAI hints at a second Millennium Prize result
items.sentence: Days after the 10,000-agent Navier–Stokes result, OpenAI claims 'substantial progress' on another Millennium Prize problem — rumored to be the Hodge conjecture — per The Neuron.

items.title: DOJ probes Nvidia's $20 billion Groq deal
items.sentence: The Justice Department is investigating whether the chipmaker's $20 billion licensing arrangement with Groq was structured to avoid merger review, per Axios.

items.title: SoftBank negotiates majority stake in 1X at $6 billion
items.sentence: The Information reports talks for a majority stake in the OpenAI-backed humanoid maker at roughly $6 billion, well below the $10 billion 1X sought last fall.

items.title: Universal and ElevenLabs strike an artist remix deal
items.sentence: Universal Music and ElevenLabs agreed to a multi-year remix platform in which artists opt in to licensed AI versions of their work, per The Neuron.

items.title: Anthropic plans its first India office
items.sentence: Reuters reports the company will open its first India office in 2026 as the competition for that market heats up, per Seeking Alpha's summary.
